messages.TMA_JSON_INVALID: {where}: the file is not a JSON object.
messages.TMA_SCHEMA_NEWER: {where}: schema {value} needs a newer game build (this one reads schema {schema}).
messages.TMA_ID_MISMATCH: {where}: id "{value}" must equal the bundle folder name "{expected}".
messages.TMA_AIRPORT_INVALID: {where}: "{value}" is not a four-character ICAO code.
messages.TMA_AIRPORT_NOT_IN_TMA: {where}: airport "{value}" is not in the TMA's airports.
messages.TMA_AIRPORT_NO_OWNER: {where}: airport "{value}" has no owner in this layout.
messages.TMA_AIRPORT_TWO_OWNERS: {where}: airport "{value}" has two owners in this layout.
messages.TMA_UNIT_NO_SERVICES: {where}: has no services. Use one or more of: {allowed}.
messages.TMA_UNIT_SERVICE_UNKNOWN: {where}: service "{value}" is not in the list. Use one or more of: {allowed}.
messages.TMA_UNIT_AIRPORT_MISSING: {where}: a {value} unit must name its airport.
messages.TMA_FREQUENCY_INVALID: {where}: frequency "{value}" must look like 131.125 and lie between 118.000 and 136.990 MHz.
messages.TMA_POSITION_ONE_SECTOR: {where}: a position works exactly one sector; "{value}" is not one sector id.
messages.TMA_SECTOR_TWICE: {where}: sector "{value}" has two positions in this layout.
messages.TMA_POSITION_NAME: {where}: name "{value}" must be capital words joined by " + ", such as APPROACH + DIRECTORS.
messages.TMA_POSITION_NOT_PLAYABLE: {where}: unit "{value}" cannot be played. Only sectors you can play are listed; a position's unit needs one of: {allowed}.
messages.TMA_POSITION_FREQUENCY_NOT_UNITS: {where}: frequency "{value}" is not one of unit "{expected}"'s frequencies.
messages.TMA_LEVEL_INVALID: {where}: level "{value}" must be F and three digits (F130) or A and three digits (A060).
messages.TMA_AGREEMENT_NO_LEVEL: {where}: agreement "{value}" needs a climb or a descent level.
messages.TMA_AGREEMENT_SAME_UNIT: {where}: agreement "{value}" goes from a unit to itself.
messages.TMA_AGREEMENT_PRIORITY_TIE: {where}: agreements "{value}" and "{expected}" cover the same traffic with the same priority.
